title: Vector Embedding Evaluation Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Embedding models, similarity tests, language coverage, and retrieval performance. The Vector Embedding Evaluation Database tests the numeric representations that power semantic search, recommendations, and RAG: which embedding models capture meaning well, in which languages, at what cost. Records include model cards (dimensions, training data, license), similarity test suites (paraphrase, analogy, contradiction detection), multilingual coverage tables, and retrieval-performance numbers. A bad embedding silently degrades everything built on it — this database makes embedding quality visible.

title: Vector Embedding Evaluation Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Embeddings map text to vectors where cosine similarity approximates semantic similarity: sim(a,b) = (a.b)/(|a||b|). Dimensions typically 384-4096; larger is not always better. Tests: paraphrase (same meaning, different words -> high sim), contradiction (opposite meaning -> low sim), STS benchmarks (correlation with human scores), retrieval (recall@k). Multilingual: aligned spaces let English queries match Spanish docs; quality drops for low-resource languages — measured per language, never assumed. Cost: inference ms/query and memory; matryoshka-style truncatable embeddings allow dim/quality trade-offs. Failure modes: anisotropy (all vectors point one way), length bias, domain shift.

demo.title: Execution: identity resolution matching
demo.code: function jw(a,b){a=a.toLowerCase();b=b.toLowerCase();if(a===b)return 1;let m=0;const n=Math.min(a.length,b.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]===b[i])m++;return m/Math.max(a.length,b.length);}const pairs=[['Jon Smith','John Smith'],['Jon Smith','Maria Garcia']];const scored=pairs.map(([x,y])=>({x,y,s:+jw(x,y).toFixed(2)}));J({scored});assert(scored[0].s>scored[1].s,'match');

title: Vector Embedding Evaluation Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: metric test (cosine and correlation match hand computation); suite test (known-good pairs score above threshold, known-bad below); determinism test; cost test (measured, not estimated). Limitations: suites are small relative to real corpora; domain shift is the eternal caveat; bias probes are included but not exhaustive. Model cards carry training-data descriptions and license terms.

demo.title: Execution: pipeline stage hashing and replay
demo.code: const crypto=require('crypto');function h(s){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex').slice(0,8);}const stages=['import','clean','validate','export'];const data='raw-data-v1';let cur=data;const hashes=stages.map(s=>{cur=s+':'+cur;return s+'='+h(cur);});const replay=(()=>{let c=data;return stages.map(s=>{c=s+':'+c;return s+'='+h(c);});})();J({hashes:hashes.length,replayMatch:JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay)});assert(JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay),'replay');
